  "evidence_to_check": "Check for comparative tables with standard explanation methods and any user study results or quantitative interpretability scores.",

  "why_it_matters": "Without comparison to SOTA, it is impossible to determine if the proposed method offers a meaningful advance in explainability or if it is merely a novel visualization of existing concepts, undermining the SIGN-SOT and SIGN-DOM impact.",
  "reviewer_dimension": "SIGN"
}
